source: Daniel E. Sichel, The Price of Nails since 1695: A Window into Economic Change, NBER Working Paper 29617 (December 2021), Table 1, column 1
note: eras is the paper’s average yearly percent change in the real price of nails (relative to consumer prices). index compounds those into six points, 1790 = 100. It is not a yearly series: the year-by-year prices from 1695 are in the paper’s replication package on openICPSR, which needs a login.
